# Drip vs Sprinkler Irrigation

Two options were evaluated for delivering water from the manifold described in [Water System Overview](architecture-water-system-overview.md).

## Option 1: Drip lines (recommended)

Lowest water use, precise per-plot delivery, works at low gravity pressure.

## Option 2: Sprinklers

Simpler to install but wasteful at our pressure and prone to overspray.

## Ruling

Adopt drip lines for all four zones. A future note on fittings is planned at [Fitting Sizes](/knowledge-base/reference-fitting-sizes.md), not yet written.
